job.title: Marketing Coordinator
description: Mission Valley Medical Group cares for 90,000 patients across 9 clinics in San Diego County. Our marketing team helps patients find the right care and keeps our healthcare brand consistent everywhere they see it — from clinic signage to patient newsletters.
About the role
The Marketing Coordinator supports campaigns for new clinic openings, flu-season and wellness programs, and patient communications. You'll work closely with our Marketing Manager and clinic leaders.
Responsibilities
- Plan, write and schedule posts for our Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn pages
- Build and send patient and community email campaigns
- Coordinate printed materials and signage with vendors and clinic staff
- Track campaign results and prepare a monthly report
- Help plan community health fairs and clinic open houses
Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications or a related field
- 0–2 years of marketing experience (internships count)
- Experience managing social media accounts for a brand or organization
- Experience with an email marketing platform (HubSpot, Mailchimp, or similar)
- Design skills in Canva or Adobe Creative Suite
- Strong writing and proofreading
Nice to have
- Bilingual English/Spanish
- Experience in healthcare marketing
Pay and schedule
$52,000 – $58,000 per year. Full-time, Monday – Friday, on-site in Mission Valley.
